$comment: Multi-layer parity acceptance config — copy to quality/parity.config.json in the target project and edit for YOUR reference/local pages. Consumed by scripts/check-parity-suite.mjs (the L1-L5 gate; reference: scripts/check-parity-suite.reference.mjs) and scripts/parity-block-loop.mjs (block depth + continuum sweep; reference: scripts/parity-block-loop.reference.mjs). NOTHING here is site-specific by design: every value below is an example against a placeholder reference.example page. referenceUrl is the ground-truth page being replicated; localUrl is the build under test. All comment keys ($comment, $sectionsComment, ...) are ignored by the loader.
$breakpointsComment: The widths the L1-L5 suite captures at. name is used as an artifact directory (must match [A-Za-z0-9._-]+). matrixBreakpoint (optional) names the width at which the L2 element matrix + L1 content are sampled (width-invariant layers); defaults to the last breakpoint.
$widthsComment: canonicalWidths is what `--width all` expands to in the block-loop; defaults to the breakpoint widths. widthHeights pairs a viewport height with each capture width (defaults filled from breakpoints). widthRange bounds any single arbitrary `--width N` (between-canonical widths are first-class — that is where responsive-tier gaps hide).
$floorsComment: The signed acceptance floors. A project may TIGHTEN these; loosening sectionScoreFloor emits a warning so a weakened gate cannot pass silently. sectionScoreFloor = L3 per-section AA-tolerant pixelmatch floor. boxTolPx/positionTolPx = L2 geometry tolerances (fonts/colors are exact). pixelmatchThreshold/includeAA tune the AA-immune pixel diff. geomTolPx/paintPxTolPx/opacityTol = full-subtree diff tolerances.
$sweepComment: Continuum-sweep knobs (block-loop --sweep). step = geometry grid (grid-aligned to min so canonical breakpoints land on samples). viewportHeight holds vh-layout constant across widths. tol/absFloor/jumpTol/baselinePctl/strongTol tune band detection. pixelStep = coarse pixel-channel grid; pixelFine overlays a finer grid over [pixelFineFrom..pixelFineTo] (the half-screen review band). Geometry-only 0 bands is NOT pixel-perfect — the pixel channel is what catches same-tier drift.
$prepareComment: Capture-determinism knobs — the earned lessons, all config-driven. cookieDismissSelectors: consent/cookie controls to click before capture. suppressSelectors: elements to display:none (timed overlays, promos, sticky banners that would poison a capture — a determinism hide, never a gate mask). counterSelectors: JS count-up regions to poll until settled (they ignore reduced-motion). pinScripts: page-context expressions to pin YOUR carousel/autoplay to slide 0 (a generic Swiper walk is built in; add one string per bespoke carousel). renderGates (PD-16): selectors that must be present + non-empty before a shot — if one never fills, the sample FAILS with a named reason and is never scored (never score a half-rendered page). settleMs* are the post-prepare quiet periods.

renderGates.note: hero must render before the first shot (lazy third-party mount)

$pickMapComment: Generic pick -> relative-selector map for the L2 element matrix. Override any entry for your markup; element entries may also carry an explicit {custom:true, local, live} pair when a pick is not enough.
$sectionsComment: Each section maps a stable local id to a root selector on BOTH the local build and the reference page. These are the L1/L3 comparison units and the block-loop's --block ids. Both selectors are Playwright-engine selectors.
$elementsComment: Curated key elements for the L2 computed-style matrix. pick resolves via pickMap inside the section root on both sides; index selects the nth match; custom entries carry explicit local/live selectors. role is a human label.
$hoverComment: L4 hover probes. Each hovers `trigger` and reads computed `props` off `target` (defaults to trigger) BEFORE and AFTER, on BOTH sites; a mismatch is reported when the two sites' before->after deltas differ. Selectors are section-root-relative.
$behaviorsComment: L4 boolean behaviour probes (config-driven generic types). A FAIL is when the local boolean differs from the reference boolean (or the local probe errors). Types: single-open {itemSelector, triggerSelector?} — opening item 2 closes item 1 (accordion); toggle-visible {trigger, target} — clicking trigger reveals target (modal/menu); persist-dismiss {banner, dismiss} — the IN-CONTEXT persistence probe: see the banner on-screen, dismiss it, RELOAD THE SAME CONTEXT, assert it stays off-screen (never a fresh context, never a CSS-only visibility check); recompute {input, output} — changing the input changes the output region's text.

behaviors.note: accepting then reloading keeps the banner hidden (same-context persistence)

$masksComment: Optional regions that legitimately differ (dynamic timestamps, third-party embeds). Reserved for masked-diff extensions; recorded for auditability. Each: { page: '*'|pathname, selectorOrRect }.
